business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale Distribution of Clinical Diagnostic ELISA Assays and Reagents

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: Marshall Islands (Non-Resident Domestic Business Corporation Regime)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid - U.S.-derived common law foundation (Business Corporations Act 1990 modeled on the Delaware General Corporation Law) with a Marshallese customary law overlay; written Constitution of 1979; no application of Islamic Sharia.
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: United States-Republic of the Marshall Islands Compact of Free Association (Amended 2003) - investment facilitation, most-favored-nation market access, and free trade framework with the United States.
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations Plus (PACER Plus) - ratified and in force, regional trade and investment facilitation framework.
Pacific Island Countries Trade Agreement (PICTA) - WTO-referenced preferential trade framework among Pacific Islands Forum states.
No comprehensive bilateral investment treaty or double taxation agreement network of substantive effect is in force for the Republic of the Marshall Islands.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Business Corporations Act 1990 (RMI) governing non-resident domestic business corporations; Anti-Money Laundering and Countering the Financing of Terrorism Act 2012, as amended (AML/CFT Act); RMI Financial Intelligence Unit (FIU) directives and AML/CFT regulations binding on licensed registered agents; Proceeds of Crime and asset-confiscation provisions; Registered Agent licensing and supervision regime of the RMI Maritime Administrator.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the certificate of incorporation of the parent entity (where applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry of the parent entity's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization - notarization at origin, authentication by the origin-country competent ministry, then legalization at the RMI consular post; Hague Apostille is not accepted because the Republic of the Marshall Islands is not a contracting party to the 1961 Hague Apostille Convention.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Good Standing of the parent entity (where applicable)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent company registry or foreign registered agent of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain as described above; certificate must be issued within 90 days prior to the RMI filing date.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized copy of the passport or national identification document of each shareholder, director, officer, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Passport or national identity authority of the country of origin, with notarization
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain as described above.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized affidavit of source of funds and source of wealth for each ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain as described above.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized power of attorney appointing the licensed RMI registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the country of origin or registered agent's attorney-in-fact
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain as described above.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Foreign bank reference letter and banker's introduction covering the ultimate beneficial owners and the intended corporate banking relationship
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Consular Legalization chain as described above; bank-issued letters are typically admitted with notarization and authenticated bank signature, while consular legalization remains mandatory where the letter is an integral part of the RMI filing.

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory screening at onboarding and ongoing risk-based screening of all ultimate beneficial owners, directors, officers, and authorized signatories against the United Nations Security Council Consolidated List, the U.S. OFAC SDN List, EU/E3 Consolidated Sanctions Lists, and the domestic RMI FIU terrorism designation list. Politically Exposed Persons must undergo enhanced due diligence with documented source-of-wealth and source-of-funds verification. Suspicious transaction reports must be filed with the RMI FIU in accordance with the statutory deadlines of the AML/CFT Act, and UBO records must be retained for at least five years after termination of the business relationship.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Office of the Registrar of Corporations - RMI eRegistry corporate name availability search and name reservation facility (administered by the RMI Maritime Administrator through licensed registered agents).
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: The statutory corporate name must be rendered in the Latin/English alphabet; non-English or Marshallese-language names are permitted only in Latin transliteration. The registered name must contain a mandatory corporate suffix: Corporation, Incorporated, Limited, or recognized abbreviations (Corp., Inc., Ltd.). Non-Latin scripts, special characters beyond standard punctuation, and symbols are not registrable as the primary corporate name.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Medical / Pharmaceutical / Clinical (triggering Ministry of Health or statutory licensing review for regulated healthcare import and distribution activities)
Government / Republic / Sovereignty / Crown / Royal / State / Federal
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant, through its licensed registered agent, may submit a written reconsideration request to the Registrar of Corporations within 14 calendar days, attaching a legal opinion distinguishing the proposed name from conflicting or prohibited registrations. If the Registrar affirms the rejection, an administrative appeal may be lodged with the RMI Maritime Administrator, and thereafter the applicant may seek judicial review in the High Court of the Republic of the Marshall Islands within 21 days. A name reservation that expires without filing is not automatically extended; renewal requires re-filing and payment of the applicable reservation fee.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: The statutory registered office must be a physical street address in the Marshall Islands maintained at the premises of the licensed RMI registered agent; a remote or client-directed virtual office cannot serve as the statutory registered office. A virtual administrative arrangement is permissible for the client's commercial back-office functions performed outside the RMI, provided the entity conducts no revenue-generating activity within the territory of the Republic of the Marshall Islands. Commercial substance for the wholesale distribution of clinical diagnostic ELISA assays and IVD reagents is evidenced by enforceable supply contracts, customs and import-export documentation, quality-management records, and beneficial-ownership documentation held in the registered agent's file.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low - approximately 5-10% annual probability of an unannounced physical on-site inspection targeting a low-risk-standard wholesale distribution entity. Periodic AML/CFT compliance inspections by the RMI FIU are directed primarily at licensed registered agents' records, with on-site examinations expected on a 3-to-5-year cycle.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market fixed annual fee for non-resident business corporation administration

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory government fee schedule under the Business Corporations Act 1990

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: First-year RMI annual government corporation fee for a non-resident domestic business corporation
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: RMI Office of the Registrar of Corporations (Maritime Administrator)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory annual government schedule based on authorized capital tier

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Company registry or registered agent of the country of origin
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory registry fee plus prevailing agent retrieval charges

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: Business Corporations Act 1990, as amended, Title 25, Marshall Islands Revised Code (25 MIRC Ch. 1), Sections 25-101 et seq.; principally Sections 25-112 (Articles of Incorporation), 25-116 (Registered Office and Registered Agent), 25-118 (Initial Directors), 25-120 (Officers), and 25-122 (Filing Fees); read together with the Income Tax Act 1989 for the non-resident exemption regime applicable to Non-Resident Domestic Corporations.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registrar of Corporations, RMI Companies Registry, Office of the Attorney General / Ministry of Finance, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands (filings accepted via licensed RMI registered agents).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1) filed under Section 25-112 of the Business Corporations Act 1990.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: The Business Corporations Act 1990 imposes no statutory minimum paid-up capital and no government escrow or deposit is required. The Corporation may be formed with a nominal authorised share capital (commonly US$1,000 divided into 1,000 ordinary shares, of which a single share is issued to the initial subscriber); share subscription consideration is satisfied by contribution of intellectual property or cash and recorded in the share register. No capital escrow account is mandated.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the Corporation accepts the subscription of its authorized share capital by the initial subscriber and directs the Secretary to issue and register the share certificates. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that the registered office of the Corporation shall be at the office of the registered agent in Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands, and the appointment of the registered agent for service of process is hereby ratified. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that [Name] is appointed President, [Name] Secretary, and [Name] Treasurer, each to serve until successors are duly elected, with powers and duties prescribed by the Bylaws and the Business Corporations Act 1990. RESOLVED, FURTHER, that the officers are authorized to execute all ancillary documents necessary for licensing and bank account facilities.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, RMI Companies Registry (Majuro) via licensed RMI registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The incorporator or licensed registered agent submits a Name Reservation Request (Form NR-1) to the Registrar, proposing the corporate name and one alternative, together with a declaration that the name is not misleadingly similar to any existing registered entity. The Registrar checks the national register and screens restricted words (e.g., 'Bank', 'Trust', 'Assurance', 'Insurance') that would require regulatory licensing. A successful reservation is held for 60 days.
required_dossiers: Form NR-1 Name Reservation Request
Written declaration of non-confusing similarity
Agent engagement letter (no apostille or notarization required at this stage)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is refused for confusing similarity, the registered agent refiles under the alternative name within the same business week; no separate state fee is charged for the second review.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting, Execution and Notarization of Articles of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Incorporator, RMI-licensed registered agent, and notary public
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent drafts the Articles of Incorporation on the statutory BC-1 template, containing the corporate name, registered office and agent (Majuro address), authorised share structure (single-class common stock), a broad purpose clause encompassing wholesale distribution of clinical diagnostic ELISA assays and reagents, and the declaration of non-resident status under the Business Corporations Act. The incorporator executes the Articles before a notary public and the registered agent signs its duplicate consent form; all pages are countersigned and dated.
required_dossiers: Articles of Incorporation (Form BC-1), executed and notarized
Registered Agent Acceptance of Appointment (Form RA-7)
Name reservation certificate issued in Step 1
Due diligence identification of the incorporator (passport copy) and beneficial owner declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Registrar's pre-filing audit identifies a drafting defect, the agent revises and re-executes the Articles without additional state fee; the corrected filing replaces the defective draft.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Filing of Articles and Issuance of Certificate of Incorporation
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations, RMI Companies Registry (Majuro; online or in-person filing through licensed agents)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The registered agent transmits the executed Articles, the registered agent consent, and the US$500 government filing fee voucher to the Registrar via the RMI electronic corporate filing portal or in person in Majuro. The Registrar verifies compliance with Section 25-112 of the Business Corporations Act, stamps the Articles, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation with the Company's registration number and date. The certificate is the Company's primary charter document.
required_dossiers: Executed Articles of Incorporation (three originals)
Registered Agent Consent Form RA-7 (original)
Name reservation certificate
Government fee voucher evidencing US$500 treasury payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a query or defect notice is issued, the agent must file corrective Articles or provide a written explanation within 14 days; upon cure, incorporation takes effect as of the original filing date.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Organizational Governance Acts – Bylaws, First Board Resolutions and Officer Appointments
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Initial director, corporate secretary, and licensed registered agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The initial director convenes the organizational meeting (or, more commonly, acts by unanimous written consent). The Board adopts the corporate Bylaws, approves the Pro-Forma First Board Resolution covering share subscription, registered office and officer appointments, and resolves to open the share register and statutory records. The Secretary is directed to issue share certificates, maintain the register of directors, and produce an incumbency certificate for bank and licensing purposes.
required_dossiers: Unanimous written consent / organizational minutes
Corporate Bylaws certified by the Secretary
Initial share ledger and register of directors and beneficial owners
Officer incumbency certificate (for bank account and licensing applications)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: These governance instruments are not filed with any state authority; any formal defect is cured retroactively by a supplemental unanimous written consent executed by the Board.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Registrar of Corporations and Tax and Revenue Office, Ministry of Finance, Republic of the Marshall Islands
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Company files a Form NR-2 Declaration of Non-Resident Status confirming that no RMI-source business will be conducted, that all board meetings and financial transactions will take place outside of the Marshall Islands, and that the Corporation is a Non-Resident Domestic Corporation for tax purposes. The Registrar endorses the non-resident status, and the tax office records the Corporation as exempt from RMI income tax on non-RMI-source income, thus obtaining the Tax-Exempt Zone treatment for the wholesale distribution activity.
required_dossiers: Form NR-2 Declaration of Non-Resident Status
Certified copy of the Certificate of Incorporation
Board resolution confirming non-resident operational mandate
Completed tax registration questionnaire for the Income Tax Act 1989
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the tax authority questions the exemption, the Company may submit a revised declaration and a letter-ruling request to the Secretary of Finance; a curative filing may be made within 30 days of the initial determination.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Industrial and Physical Licensing – Health Wholesale Licence and Environmental Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Ministry of Health & Human Services and the RMI Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The Company submits the application for the Medical and Laboratory Reagent Wholesale Distribution Licence to the Ministry of Health, together with a Class II Environmental Registration application to the RMI EPA. The health authority verifies cold-chain storage capacity (2–8°C), handling standard operating procedures for ELISA reagents, and the appointment of a quality assurance officer. The RMI EPA reviews the chemical inventory, storage layout and spill-containment measures before issuing the environmental registration. Both endorsements are annexed to the general business licence.
required_dossiers: Application for Medical and Laboratory Reagent Wholesale Distribution Licence
RMI EPA Class II Environmental Registration application
Chemical inventory and Safety Data Sheet register for all ELISA assay reagents
Certificate of Incorporation and Certificate of Non-Resident Status
Warehouse floor plan and temperature-monitoring validation report
Fire safety clearance issued by the RMI Fire and Safety Inspectorate
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the health licence is refused, the Company may submit a corrective compliance plan and appeal to the Minister of Health within 21 days under the Public Health Act; an adverse EPA registration may be appealed to the RMI EPA Board within 14 days of the notice.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Ministry of Health & Human Services (Health Regulatory Unit), Republic of the Marshall Islands, with procedural endorsement from the RMI Environmental Protection Authority and the Registrar of Corporations
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Medical and Laboratory Reagent Wholesale Distribution Licence issued under the Public Health Act and Health and Medical Services Regulations (RMI), endorsed onto the National Business Licence

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Republic of the Marshall Islands Environmental Protection Authority (RMI EPA)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Class II – Environmental Registration (Low-Risk Wholesale and Storage; Full EIA Report Not Required)
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No process wastewater may be discharged to lagoon, groundwater, or marine waters (RMI EPA Water Quality Regulations); VOC and hazardous air emissions from cold-storage warehouse operations shall remain below detectable limits and meet the RMI Ambient Air Quality standards; expired or damaged diagnostic reagents shall be segregated as medical/hazardous waste and disposed through an RMI EPA-certified incinerator; spill-containment pallets and absorbent materials must cover the full storage footprint; a hazardous waste manifest and disposal log must be retained for at least five years.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire and Safety Inspectorate certification for fire suppression, emergency egress, and flammables storage; structural load inspection and building clearance by the Majuro municipal building authority for the warehouse (≤500 m²); occupational clearance under the RMI Workplace Health and Safety Act 2018, including annual spill-response drills, eye-wash station inspection, and biohazard-handling certification for warehouse personnel.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Revenue and Taxation Division, Ministry of Finance, Banking and Postal Services, Republic of the Marshall Islands; customs and trade facilitation handled by the Marshall Islands Customs Service within the same Ministry. There is no consolidated national online tax filing portal; registrations and declarations are processed on a paper-based or direct-submission basis at the Ministry's offices in Majuro.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: The Republic of the Marshall Islands does not operate a VAT, GST, or corporate income tax numbering registry, and therefore does not issue a statutory TIN or VAT ID to foreign entities. A non-resident Business Corporation obtains its legal identity through the Registrar of Corporations (domestic filing under the Business Corporations Act), which issues the Certificate of Incorporation and annual Certificate of Good Standing; no separate tax file number is opened unless the entity employs RMI-resident individuals, in which case an employer Wage Tax registration account is assigned by the Revenue and Taxation Division. Where the entity imports goods, the Marshall Islands Customs Service assigns an Importer of Record identifier (Customs Entry Number) at the first customs declaration; no advance tax pre-registration is required.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No domestic check-the-box, fiscal transparency, or hybrid mismatch election regime exists because the jurisdiction imposes no corporate income tax, VAT, or GST on non-resident Business Corporations. The entity may nevertheless elect to formalize its non-resident tax-exempt posture by filing a Non-Resident Business Status Declaration and obtaining an Exemption Certificate from the Registrar of Corporations; it may also voluntarily register as an employer for Wage Tax withholding if it later hires RMI citizens or residents, which is an administrative registration rather than a tax classification election.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: No VAT, GST, or Sales and Use Tax in force; indirect fiscal mechanism limited to Customs Import Duty and selective excises (alcohol, tobacco, fuel) at the border
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: Not applicable — no VAT registration threshold exists. For customs purposes, any entity importing regulated clinical diagnostics must hold a valid Business License issued by the RMI Registrar and an Importer of Record registration; the economic turnover threshold is zero because even a single import shipment creates a customs duty filing obligation at the standard MFN tariff rates applicable to the HS classification of the goods.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: No real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing, digital stamping, or API-based reporting mandate exists in the Marshall Islands. Commercial invoices are generated freely by the exporter and presented to the Customs Service with the import declaration; customs processing is conducted through the RMI Customs automated clearance system (ASYCUDA-equivalent manual/semi-electronic workflow) without government-mandated e-invoicing, digital signatures, or fiscal stamping.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Not applicable — the Marshall Islands imposes no VAT or GST, so there is no 'zero rating' mechanism for exported goods or offshore services. Goods exported from RMI territory are simply outside the scope of customs duty and no indirect tax is levied. A limited duty drawback right exists under customs regulations for import duty paid on inputs that are subsequently re-exported in the same or processed form; this is an administrative refund of customs duty rather than a VAT zero-rating claim. For the wholesale distribution of clinical diagnostic ELISA assays and reagents, no RMI indirect tax is assessed on offshore sales, and no local refund claim will arise unless duty-paid samples are re-exported.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (Outward Cargo Manifest filed with Marshall Islands Customs Service)
Bill of Lading / Air Waybill evidencing physical export from RMI jurisdiction
Inward Remittance Certificate or bank SWIFT/TT confirmation evidencing payment (kept as documentary evidence; RMI imposes no statutory FX controls)
Commercial Invoice and Packing List describing the diagnostic reagents

Certificate of Origin or Free Sale Certificate where required by the destination country; RMI does not mandate export permits for laboratory diagnostic reagents, but the exporter must maintain the supplier's ISO/CE/IVD documentation for audit purposes
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Because no VAT system exists, fraudulent export zero-rating claims are structurally unavailable; audit scrutiny instead targets customs duty drawback fraud and import undervaluation. Penalties under the Marshall Islands Customs Act include seizure and forfeiture of goods, monetary penalties of up to three times the duty evaded, revocation of the Importer of Record registration, and potential criminal fines or imprisonment for wilful falsification of customs declarations. Any duty drawback obtained on the basis of false export documentation is retrospectively clawed back with interest, and the exporter's business license may be suspended by the Registrar of Corporations. In practice, the RMI Revenue and Taxation Division reviews duty drawback claims against outward manifests, bills of lading, and bank remittance records, applying a 6-year litigation window for recovery of fraudulently obtained refunds.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: The Republic of the Marshall Islands has no statutory central bank; the Banking Commissioner appointed under the Marshall Islands Banking Act 1990 supervises licensed financial institutions, while the United States Federal Reserve System functions as the de facto monetary authority because the US dollar is the sole legal tender.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: The jurisdiction is fully dollarized: current-account convertibility is unrestricted and no exchange-approval regime applies to capital transactions. A non-resident Business Corporation may remit dividends, loan repayments, capital reductions and liquidation proceeds freely and without RMI withholding tax; the only practical hurdles are correspondent-bank due diligence, the APG mutual-evaluation findings and the FinCEN Section 971A proposed designation concerning the SOV digital-currency programme, all of which heighten documentation expectations rather than restrict convertibility.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: RMI law imposes no export-proceeds surrender or repatriation obligation: the effective conversion ratio is 0% and there is no statutory timeline for bringing export receipts onshore. Receipts may be retained in USD or any convertible foreign currency in the BC's own accounts, subject solely to AML/CFT record-keeping obligations under the Banking Act 1990 and the RMI AML/CFT Regulations 2021.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Current Account; Capital Escrow Account

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Bank of Guam (Republic of the Marshall Islands Branch)
tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.account_class: Operational USD Current Account; Settlement Account

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low as a primary treasury rail. The RMI Banking Act 1990 neither licenses nor passports digital EMI platforms, and non-resident offshore EMIs have no clearing access to RMI's domestic payment systems. An offshore EMI (e.g., UK or EU-authorized) may legally hold an account for the MH_BC as a supplementary payout conduit in EUR or GBP, but correspondent de-risking of RMI-registered entities makes it fragile; the Marshal Islands SOV digital-currency initiative is not suitable for corporate treasury operations.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For the two domestic commercial banks, at least one natural-person director must attend a physical KYC interview at the Majuro head office; fully remote account opening is not accepted for non-resident Business Corporations. Acceptance of video-conference identity verification may only be granted where the applicant already holds a recognized banking relationship at the bank's foreign branch or where an international bank outside RMI is used, in which case apostilled corporate documents, a certified register of directors and shareholders, and an RMI counsel legal opinion substitute for in-person attendance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Beneficial-ownership opacity and any outstanding bearer-share flag on the corporate record.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Notarised and apostilled register of directors and register of shareholders, a signed beneficial-ownership declaration identifying every ultimate individual holding 25% or more, a representation that no bearer shares remain outstanding, and an RMI legal opinion confirming control and ownership.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt offshore company flagged as a 'shell' due to absence of domestic taxation.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Authentic business plan for ISIC 4649.02 wholesale of clinical diagnostic ELISA assays and reagents, executed supply/distribution agreements with named manufacturers, third-party logistics and bonded warehousing evidence, purchase-order pipeline, ISO 13485/GMP quality certifications, and reviewed management accounts.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Statutory-license check for a regulated medical-device/IVD wholesale line.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Duly issued business licence from the importing jurisdictions, national health-authority product notifications, WHO/GMP batch-release certificates for the reagent catalogue, distributor authorization letters from the IVD manufacturers, and a statement that no sale occurs within the RMI domestic market, removing the need for a local foreign investment business licence.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: OFAC/sanctions and PEP screening hit associated with trading counterparties or freight routes.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Automated sanctions and PEP screening output with no unresolved alerts, invoice-to-end-customer documents, restricted-end-use certificates and end-user undertakings, airway bill and customs clearance records, and dated negative-news search snapshots covering the prior 12 months.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Correspondent-bank de-risking prompted by the RMI's APG/FinCEN scrutiny status.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Enhanced client-due-diligence file: source-of-wealth statement with bank statements, audited financial statements, a transaction matrix mapping expected turnover to the commercial model, formal low-risk rationale for the AML risk tier, and a standing undertaking to provide correspondent banks with transaction-level information on request.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant routing: remitting shareholders instruct their foreign bank to send a SWIFT MT103 wire, debited in equivalent convertible currency, credited in USD to the BC's escrowed capital account at Bank of Marshall Islands; field 70 must read 'Shareholder Capital Contribution - MH_BC - Board/Shareholder Resolution No. [X]'; before credit acceptance, BMI verifies the corporate resolution, share register and beneficial-ownership declaration, and completes an internal capital-received memorandum; USD clearing is effected over the US correspondent (Fedwire/CHIPS) network, with a purpose-code-equivalent narrative matching the RMI AML/CFT record-keeping requirement.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Primary rails: (a) SWIFT MT103 TT payments for routine reagent restocking under USD 500,000 per invoice; (b) irrevocable sight commercial letters of credit transmitted via SWIFT MT700, governed by UCP600 and Incoterms 2020, for purchase orders above USD 500,000; (c) SWIFT MT101 aggregated customer-transfer instructions for multi-supplier payment runs. All outbound disbursements cite the underlying purchase order, supplier invoice and Incoterms; the bank's trade-finance unit screens each beneficiary against OFAC/UN sanctions before effecting settlement through RMI accounts maintained at US correspondents.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/EUR deliverable FX forward (30/60/90-day tenors) executed under a master FX agreement with a licensed offshore bank
USD/CNH non-deliverable forward (NDF) to hedge renminbi-denominated supply contracts from mainland China manufacturers
USD/AUD cross-currency swap under an ISDA 2002 master agreement for supplier payments to Australian distributors
Zero-cost FX collar (put-spread/call-spread combination) on the aggregate USD/EUR commercial exposure
Cross-currency interest-rate swap (CCIRS) aligning USD funding costs with EUR-denominated trade receivables

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Report filing for Marshall Islands Business Corporation under the Business Corporations Act, Title 51 of the Marshall Islands Revised Code
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations, Office of the Attorney General, Majuro, Republic of the Marshall Islands; submitted through the licensed RMI registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Anniversary-based: due on or before the last day of the anniversary month of incorporation each year; standard calendar-cycle filers must file by 31 March
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late payment penalty of 10% of the annual government fee; continued failure to file or pay for one full annual cycle permits the Registrar to issue a notice of administrative dissolution and strike the corporation off the register, resulting in loss of legal capacity

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Registered office and registered agent continuation declaration included in the Annual Report
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Registrar of Corporations through the licensed RMI registered agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Concurrent with the Annual Report; any change of registered agent or registered office must be filed within 30 days of the change
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to maintain a registered office and registered agent in RMI constitutes non-compliance; the Registrar may designate a substitute agent and administrative dissolution may follow if not cured

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: No compulsory independent audit for a private, non-resident, tax-exempt Business Corporation unless it is listed on a securities exchange, holds a regulated financial or insurance license, or is ordered by the Registrar or a court; otherwise, only accurate books and records are required
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: RMI does not prescribe a domestic GAAP for non-resident tax-exempt private corporations; financial statements, where prepared, are maintained under International Financial Reporting Standards or US GAAP at the directors' election

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: RMI does not require a separate public UBO annual filing. The licensed registered agent must maintain and verify current beneficial ownership records under RMI AML/CFT obligations, confirm UBO data at least annually, and update records within 30 days of any share transfer or issued-change event. The Annual Report confirms issued share capital and the registered members of record as of the filing date.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 3,500 - USD 9,500 per engagement if an independent audit is voluntarily obtained; not statutorily required for a non-resident tax-exempt Business Corporation

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: A non-resident domestic Business Corporation is wholly exempt from Marshall Islands income tax under the Tax and Revenue Code; all foreign-source income from wholesale distribution is non-taxable. No payroll or social security tax applies. A 3% gross revenue tax applies only to businesses deriving income from sources within the RMI, which the non-resident entity must avoid. No capital gains, wealth, or annual net-worth tax is levied.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: RMI Annual Corporate Franchise Tax Statement / Business Corporations Act Annual Report — filed with the RMI Registrar of Corporations through the licensed registered agent in Majuro (no direct corporate income tax return is required for a non-resident BC).
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Due on the anniversary of the certificate of incorporation; the renewal, annual report and franchise tax payment must be completed no later than the last day of the month in which the incorporation anniversary falls.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Registered corporate name, incorporation number and date of incorporation as recorded in the BCA registry.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: State the exact RMI charter name; the certificate of incorporation issued at formation anchors eligibility for non-resident status.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part II – Registered Office and Registered Agent
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Physical registered office address in Majuro and the licensed registered agent's name and consent.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A registered agent in the RMI is mandatory; a local business address may be the agent's office, but no domiciliation or local staff is required for the distribution of laboratory reagents.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Names, nationalities and addresses of the officers and directors in office at the filing date.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Directors and shareholders of any nationality are permitted; exact beneficial ownership data must be held by the registered agent for AML/CFT compliance.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Class, par value and number of authorized shares; used to compute annual franchise tax.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Specify shares actually issued to the ultimate IVD trading investor; the franchise tax base is the authorized share structure and must be kept consistent with the distribution entity's capital profile.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Part V – Non-Resident Domestic Corporation Self-Declaration
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Certification that no part of gross income was derived from sources within the Republic of the Marshall Islands during the taxable period.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: For a wholesale ELISA assay and reagents business, certifying is legally effective only if title, risk, procurement and payment flows occur outside RMI; invoicing a domestic RMI hospital or clinic invalidates the declaration and subjects the company to gross revenue tax on those receipts.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Non-filing or non-payment of the annual franchise tax results in loss of good standing, suspension of the right to transact business while in default, and a reinstatement fee plus arrears; two consecutive years of default expose the corporation to involuntary dissolution by the Registrar. Directors acting during default are liable under general company law principles.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0% — the RMI imposes no withholding tax on dividends paid to non-resident shareholders; distributions from a non-resident BC may be repatriated without RMI tax.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: RMI has no comprehensive double tax treaty network, so no domestic DTA relief form is required; because the RMI does not levy withholding tax, treaty relief is logically unnecessary. When a counterparty in the distribution chain demands residence proof, the registered agent obtains a Certificate of Good Standing (non-statutory tax residence confirmation) from the RMI Registrar; the same certificate supports treaty claims only where the foreign court recognizes RMI corporate residence.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: 0% for royalties paid for trademarks, technology transfer, assays, and for interest on intercompany debt; RMI levies no withholding tax on outbound payments, and available treaty rates are generally 0% in the absence of an RMI taxing right.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Not applicable — RMI levies no corporate income tax and has enacted no transfer-pricing documentation requirement, Local File or Master File threshold. If the BC is a controlled wholesale distribution entity of a multinational group, transfer-pricing documentation is nevertheless required by the parent's tax jurisdiction under OECD BEPS standards (commonly triggered above EUR 750,000 intragroup revenues).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: The RMI has not enacted Economic Substance Regulations and imposes no ESR profit or economic-presence test on non-resident business corporations; however, foreign CFC, anti-avoidance and bank-due-diligence rules require the entity to demonstrate genuine commercial activity, including physical records, director oversight, procurement contracts, and payment flows consistent with its IVD reagent wholesale function.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.infraction_category: Tax Evasion and False Non-Resident Declaration
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Using the zero-tax RMI coating to mis-invoice ELISA assay procurement, fabricating margins, or siphoning group profits where the RMI company has no real distribution function, or falsely declaring non-resident status while deriving income from RMI sources.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Under the RMI Tax and Revenue Code, false declarations attract criminal fines and imprisonment for up to three years, together with re-assessment of the 3% gross revenue tax, interest and penalties on previously exempt receipts; tax authorities in the customer market (US, EU, LATAM, APAC) may additionally impose CFC, FATCA and GAAR adjustments, including interest and penalties up to 100-120% of the avoided foreign tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who knowingly sign false certificates may be prosecuted individually; RMI courts following Delaware veil-piercing doctrine will hold directors jointly and severally liable for restitution of diverted profits and unpaid taxes where the corporation is operated as an alter ego.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating exclusively through nominee officers, maintaining no board minutes, books, procurement contracts, or transactional evidence, holding no capital commensurate with the reagent distribution business, and routing funds in a circular fashion to mislead counterparties.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Although the RMI imposes no domestic ESR penalty, the Registrar may initiate involuntary dissolution proceedings and the company will be universally treated as a shell by financial institutions, leading to account termination and consortium blacklisting; EU and OECD defensive measures may strip extraterritorial tax benefits and deny treaty access in all trading jurisdictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The corporate veil can be pierced for fraud, undercapitalization and complete control; directors face civil restitution, disqualification orders, and in aggravated cross-border fraud cases, travel bans and extradition requests supported by INTERPOL notices.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Processing large Swift wire transactions for IVD reagent cargo without CDD on counterparties, failing to maintain beneficial ownership records with the registered agent, failing to report suspicious transactions to the RMI Financial Intelligence Unit, or transacting with sanctioned persons and restricted jurisdictions in the healthcare procurement chain.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: RMI AML/CFT legislation (as amended) provides for monetary penalties of up to US$1 million and imprisonment for up to five years for money laundering and failure to report; due diligence failures by the registered agent also trigger revocation of the corporate license, asset freezing, and correspondent banking restrictions.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Officers and compliance directors bear personal criminal exposure for knowing participation in laundering of proceeds and sanctions evasion; civil claims from defrauded procurement ministries are enforceable against directors personally where the entity was merely a conduit.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: The non-resident BC supplying clinical diagnostic reagents or assays to a local RMI hospital, clinic or trading agent without a valid RMI business license and without registration for the foreign-owned business gross revenue tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Operation without a license is punishable as a misdemeanor under the RMI Business Licensing Law with fines, imprisonment of up to one year, forfeiture of profits, and retroactive imposition of the 3% gross revenue tax plus penalties; the certified non-resident tax-exempt status is revoked.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who authorized local sales are personally liable for unpaid taxes and licensing penalties; veil-piercing is available to tax authorities and creditors where the entity continued trading after revocation of its non-resident status.
